title: Remote viewing Joan of Arc
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of Remote viewing Joan of Arc, about 15th century (target); session in the 1980s at France (target), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Oh, things like um Jon of Arc.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former US Army sergeant who worked as a remote viewer in the 1980s, meaning someone trained to perceive hidden people and places with the mind, says the targets he was given sometimes included historical figures. He names Joan of Arc, the French heroine of the 1400s, as one of them, which if true would mean the method was thought to reach back through time.
